education and american ideals
The Synthetic Shelf Act
(invented for tests; not a text the organization published)
Model Legislation
A. Drafter, Example University
WHEREAS, an invented reason to keep books on shelves; and
WHEREAS, another invented reason;
2 ethics and public policy center · www.eppc.org
BE IT ENACTED:
SECTION A
(1) Each school in [state] shall keep a shelf of printed books.
(2) By [date specified] the board shall report on the shelves.
SECTION B
The [Chief State School Officer] may adopt rules under this act.
DEFINITIONS
1) "Shelf" means a fixed rack for books.
Pat Example is a Senior Fellow at an example center and an invented person.
Sam Sample is Contributing Editor of an example review.
